simple.summary: חׇזְקָה (chozqâh) means vehemence (usually in a bad sense) First listed occurrence: 1Sam 2 16.

definitions.full: H2394. chozqah חָזְקָה noun feminine strength, force, violence , always בְּחָזְקָה with strength, force , etc.; — 1 of oppression Judg 4:3 forcibly, violently ; capture by force 1Sam 2:16 ; Ezek 34:4 of ruling ׳בְּח וּבְמָּ֑רֶךְ with force and with rigour. 2 rebuke severely, sharply Judg 8:1 ; cry mightily , insistently Jonah 3:8 . — לֲחָזְקָה 2Kin 12:13 see חָזַק Qal Infinitive
